mapper.select: select curr.bok_detail_id as bokDetailId, curr.subject_no as subjectNo, curr.o_ccy as oCcy, SUM(curr.o_happen_amt * if(curr.cd_flag = 'C', 1, 0)) as cInterBalance, SUM(curr.o_happen_amt * if(curr.cd_flag = 'D', 1, 0)) as dInterBalance from BOK_BOOKDETAIL_CURRENT curr where curr.bookset_id = #{booksetId} and curr.happen_date > #{preDate} and curr.happen_date <= #{happenDate} group by curr.bok_detail_id, curr.subject_no, curr.o_ccy
